subject.title: Document the cloud-orchestrator plus local-text-workers pattern

question: Which open docs PR should be the canonical implementation for this issue?
rationale: The issue is clear and current main is still missing the page, but two open PRs now carry closing references for the same docs gap, so automation should not queue another fix or choose branch ownership silently.

options.title: Pick and land one existing PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100634 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101209, land the stronger current branch, and close the duplicate while preserving contributor credit.

options.title: Keep both under review
options.body: Leave both open until maintainers compare them, accepting duplicate review cost for the same docs surface.

options.title: Restart from a fresh docs PR
options.body: Close both only if neither branch is suitable; current evidence shows they are focused attempts at the requested page.

recommendation.title: Pick and land one existing PR
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100634 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101209, land the stronger current branch, and close the duplicate while preserving contributor credit.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the best available routing owner from current adjacent docs history, while the actual branch choice remains maintainer review.
